summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for MathLessonVisualiser — a Vite+React+TypeScript web application that consumes structured JSON lesson definitions (designed for AI generation) and renders animated, interactive mathematical visualizations. Covers technology stack decisions, architecture, the JSON lesson schema, animation engine design (equation morphing, canvas animations, timeline control), UI/UX approach (Obsidian editorial theme), 7 baseline test cases, project structure, phased implementation roadmap, and open questions for the user.
